content.title: Forza Horizon 6 – Coming soon to Game Pass | Xbox
content.text: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet. Play day one with Game Pass Available May 19, 2026 Xbox Series X|S PC Handheld Cloud Play with: Xbox Series X|S PC Handheld Cloud Xbox Play Anywhere: Buy once, play on Xbox console and PC Handheld optimized Ready to play on supported handhelds Ways to play Xbox Console Forza Horizon 6 is optimized for Xbox Series X|S consoles supporting 4K Ultra HD and 60 FPS. Play it day one with Game Pass. Xbox on PC Forza Horizon 6 is included with Game Pass to play on PC. Xbox Handheld Forza Horizon 6 will be available to play on supported gaming handhelds. Xbox Cloud Gaming Stream Forza Horizon 6 with Game Pass via cloud gaming. Game features Experience Tokyo, Horizon’s largest ever city Welcome to Japan, a place where the stunning contrasts of rural and urban come together as you uncover the secrets hidden within Horizon's most dense map yet. Cruise the suburbs and iconic downtown streets or challenge yourself in the docks and industrial districts of Tokyo City. Feel immersed in Japanese car culture Drive over 550 real-world cars, including some fan favorite JDM classics. As you explore Japan, find rare Aftermarket Cars to test drive and buy, participate in Touge Battles, and experience authentic stories rooted in Japan’s legendary car culture. Race and discover in Japan Experience a vast campaign of discovery and Festival racing, playable solo and in co-op with your friends.* Start as an outsider and prove you’ve got what it takes to rise through the ranks to become a Horizon Legend. Make the whole world yours Purchase gorgeous homes in Japan – each with customizable garages allowing you to showcase your car collection. Build freely in the open world, making nearly anything you can imagine. Tune your favorite cars and upgrade them with new body kits. Join the community in multiplayer This Festival is always better with your friends.* Participate in Time Attack Circuits and Drag Meets or show off your customized cars at Car Meets. Earn new co-op LINK skills or jump into any of the Horizon Multiplayer modes. Build together, anywhere in Japan Create with freedom anywhere in Japan as you build custom events with your friends in CoLab, the upgraded EventLab toolset – now featuring multiplayer support* and additional options to bring your unique, imaginative worlds to life.
